scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare. The paper's headline quantities (V, E, S, G, and mixing properties) are reported after a full Monte Carlo simulation that cannot be rerun in a lightweight checker. Scoring compares agent's reported CSV values against paper gold values from Tables 2 and 3, with per-property tolerances and linear falloff. Structural checks on CSV shape and empty mixing columns for pure salts add minor discriminative power.

column_descriptions.G_kcalmol: Gibbs free energy in kcal/mol (with uncertainty)
column_descriptions.delta_V_cm3mol: Change in molar volume on mixing in cm³/mol
column_descriptions.delta_E_kcalmol: Change in internal energy on mixing in kcal/mol
column_descriptions.delta_S_calmolK: Change in entropy on mixing in cal/(mol·K)
column_descriptions.delta_G_kcalmol: Change in Gibbs free energy on mixing in kcal/mol

outputs.description: Reproduced zero-pressure thermodynamic properties and mixing properties for liquid NaCl, KCl, and equimolar (Na,K)Cl at T=1083 K.

output_contract.notes: The scored output is compared against hidden reference values from the paper's Monte Carlo results (Tables 2 and 3) with appropriate tolerance windows.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold thermodynamic values from paper Tables 2 and 3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper: Molecular Physics 26:1521-1532 (1973), Tables 2 and 3, MC results.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's MC column of Table 2 (V, E, S, G) and Table 3 mixing properties; same units as public contract. Verified against the reference solve.sh output.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own numerically reported results, traceable to specific tables.

steps.description: Score agreement of agent's thermodynamic properties and mixing properties with paper gold values.
